Concern: required_tech missing across most languages -- not just C#
Detail: Independent sweep (2026-08-07) found the csharp required_tech gap fixed in finishedtickets.csv was not unique to C#: go_*.py (5/5 files), python_*.py (5/5), java_*.py (5/5), and nodejs_*.py (4/4) ALL have zero rules setting required_tech -- only cpp/cmake/csharp(now)/rust are compliant. Confirmed this has real functional impact, not just style: with engine.run(target=go-sample-repo, config=Config(tech={"go": False})), go-error-ignored still ran and produced 5 findings -- a user explicitly disabling a language via tech.<lang>: false in nfr-review.yaml (documented as overriding auto-detection) does not actually suppress that language's rules for any of these four languages. 23 rule files affected.
